annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Research Council (ERC) / European Commission DG Research & Innovation
key_provisions_or_claims: Survey of 300 ERC grantees (29% response) on AI use in science and expected developments by 2030.
Top concerns: intrusive/manipulative AI (79%), black-box lack of transparency and replicability (71%), data bias (71%).
Respondents also worry about inequalities in access to data and compute, misuse, and dominance of non-EU tech firms.
Respondents strongly expect ethical guidelines for AI to be implemented (about 95-98%).
Provides evidence for the upcoming Scientific Opinion on responsible uptake of AI in science.
annotation.summary_en: European Research Council foresight report summarising a 2023 survey of ERC grantees on their present use of AI in the scientific process and expectations to 2030, including opportunities, risks such as black-box opacity, bias and misuse, and generative AI. It aims to inform EU policy on responsible AI uptake in science.
annotation.title_clean: Foresight: Use and impact of Artificial Intelligence in the scientific process
